settings.eyebrow: Iron & Chrome Classic Car Restoration · 38 years · Concours-grade
settings.headline:
Bring the legend
back to the road.
settings.copy: Iron & Chrome is a full-service classic car restoration shop for people who refuse to let a good car die. From a barn-find '67 Mustang to a concours-grade Duesenberg, we strip it, rebuild it, and hand it back better than the day it left the line. You bring the story; we bring the torque wrenches, the period-correct parts, and the patience.

trust_list.text: Full rotisserie restoration, frame-off to concours
Period-correct parts sourcing across three continents
In-house machine shop, upholstery, and paint booth
Every build documented with photo and video logs

settings.title: Every era,
settings.intro: Whether it's a pre-war brass car or a 90s Japanese icon, we treat every build as a one-of-one. Here's the work we do best.

design.title: Frame-off rotisserie
design.text: The body comes completely off the frame and spins on a rotisserie so every panel, seam, and undercarriage surface gets the same obsessive attention as the paint.

design.title: Concours & show builds
design.text: For the cars that will be judged, we restore to factory-correct spec with NOS and period-correct hardware, down to the correct hose clamps and date-coded glass.

build.title: Engine & drivetrain
build.text: In-house machine shop for blocks, heads, and rotating assemblies. We rebuild to stock, hot-rod, or restomod spec — your call, your power curve.

build.title: Suspension & brakes
build.text: Period-correct or modernized, we make sure the car stops and steers as well as it looks. Every build gets a full alignment and road test before delivery.

launch.title: Paint & body
launch.text: A dedicated downdraft booth and a painter who's been laying lacquer and modern two-stage for three decades. Color-matched to the original or your wildest idea.

launch.title: Interior & upholstery
launch.text: In-house trim shop for seats, door panels, headliners, and carpets — stitched in correct materials, from original leather to period vinyl.

settings.title: We treat your car
settings.intro: Anyone can bolt on new parts. We restore the car you remember — the one that smells right, sounds right, and starts on the first crank. Here's what that takes.

features.title: Documented, not guessed
features.text: Every build gets a photo and video log from teardown to first start. You'll see exactly what we found and exactly what we did.

features.title: Parts that match the year
features.text: We source NOS and period-correct parts across three continents, and machine what we can't find. No wrong-era parts, ever.

features.title: One point of contact
features.text: A single project manager owns your build from intake to delivery. One phone number, one person who knows your car cold.

features.title: No surprises on the invoice
features.text: We quote the work, show you the teardown, and only proceed with your sign-off. The price you approve is the price you pay.

features.title: Built to be driven
features.text: A show car that won't start is a sculpture. We set up every build to be driven — to the show, to the coast, and back.

features.title: Warranty on the work
features.text: Our craftsmanship is backed by a two-year warranty on restoration work. If it's our fault, it's our fix.

settings.title: From the barn
settings.intro: Every restoration follows the same disciplined path. Here's what to expect from the day your car rolls in to the day you turn the key.

steps.title: Intake & assessment
steps.text: We photograph, inspect, and document your car's condition, then give you an honest, itemized quote for the work you want done.

steps.title: Teardown & catalog
steps.text: The car comes apart completely. Every part is tagged, photographed, and cataloged so nothing gets lost and nothing gets guessed.

steps.title: Body, paint & assembly
steps.text: Metalwork, paint, and reassembly happen in sequence, with progress photos at every milestone. You watch it come back to life.

steps.title: Road test & delivery
steps.text: We align, tune, and road-test the finished car, then hand you the keys, the build book, and a car that starts on the first crank.

settings.note: Most restorations take 6 to 18 months depending on scope. We'll give you a realistic timeline up front and keep you posted at every milestone — no surprises, no disappearing acts.

settings.title: The cars they
settings.intro: We asked owners what it felt like to see their car come home. They said: the smell, the sound, and the moment the key turned. Here's a few of their answers.

reviews.quote: My father bought this '67 fastback in 1971 and I grew up in the back seat. When it finally died, I thought that was the end of the story. Iron & Chrome gave me back the car AND the memory. I cried when I heard it start.
reviews.author: Dana W.

reviews.quote: They found NOS parts I'd been hunting for a decade. The build book they handed me is a work of art in itself. This is the only shop I'd trust with a car that means something.
reviews.author: Marcus L.

reviews.quote: I was terrified of the cost and the timeline. They were honest at every step, showed me the teardown, and delivered two weeks early. The car drives better than it did in 1963.
reviews.author: Elena V.

settings.title: Tell us about
settings.intro: Send us a few photos and the story of your car. We'll reply within one business day with an honest assessment and next steps. No pressure, no hard sell.
settings.location: Iron & Chrome Classic Car Restoration · 88 Foundry Lane, Motor City

settings.blurb: A full-service classic car restoration shop for people who refuse to let a good car die — frame-off restorations, period-correct parts, and craftsmanship that's built to be driven.
